## Block Markup

This is a **dynamic block**. It is rendered on the server and does not save HTML in post content.

In post content, it is stored as a block comment:

```html
<!-- wp:categories {"taxonomy":"category","displayAsDropdown":false,"showHierarchy":false,"showPostCounts":false,"showOnlyTopLevel":false,"showEmpty":false,"showLabel":true} /-->
```
